title: Service command to report a message from IRC
description:
A user who wants to report a message has no way to do it from IRC. One of the two gaps service.rs's Limitations names: "reports and removing participants have no command in v1".

mimid-agent-store owns what a message keeps for a report, so the data is there and this is a surface, not a feature.

WHAT TO ADD: a service command taking the message a user is reporting, by the msgid their client showed (bead mimid-1wgh.138.3 turns that ULID into a message), and doing what the store's report path does with it. Say in the reply where the report went and who can read it, because a user reporting a message to their own provider and a user reporting it to the room's hub are doing different things, and the word "report" hides which.

FRANKING IS THE POINT, and the reason this is worth doing properly: mimi-protocol-07's franking is what lets a report be verified rather than asserted, so a report that drops the franking data is a report the recipient cannot check. Read what the store keeps before designing the reply, and if the franking material is not retained for the message being reported, say so in the bead rather than reporting without it.

When this lands, rewrite service.rs's Limitations sentence.
